# Script reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from docs/scripting.yml; edit that file, not this page. -->

The functions and commands of the game's script language. Each signature is written as a TypeScript declaration. A
function returns a value; a command returns `void`. The types are `number`, `string`, `object` and `group`; `name?` is
an argument a call may leave out, and `...name` may be given again and again. Names ignore ASCII case. A condition is a
number: 0 is false.

Entries tagged <span class="eix">eix</span> are added or changed by eix: the functions and commands that addon.dll adds,
and the changes that SpellAddon options make to the game's own. The others are the original game's. A note headed
*Differs from the original* says where eix behaves differently.

## Script flow

Waiting, stopping and looping over groups.

### Any

```ts
function Any(variable: object, group: group, condition: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the condition is nonzero for at least one object of the group, with the variable set to each object in
turn; otherwise 0.

### Every

```ts
function Every(variable: object, group: group, condition: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the condition is nonzero for every object of the group, with the variable set to each object in turn;
otherwise 0.

### For

```ts
function For(variable: object, group: group): void
```

Runs the loop body once for every object of the group, with the global variable set to that object. The group can be a
diplomatic group, a game group, or the result of `GroupAdd` or `GroupCross`.

### ForIf

```ts
function ForIf(variable: object, group: group, condition: number): void
```

Like `For`, but runs the body only for the objects for which the condition is nonzero.

### KillScript

```ts
function KillScript(): void
```

Stops the running script. Map script modules only; the first command of a script body, as a rule.

### Sleep

```ts
function Sleep(ticks: number): void
```

Pauses the script for the given time, in 1/15 s units. Works in map script modules only.

### SleepUntil

```ts
function SleepUntil(condition: number): void
```

Pauses the script until the condition becomes nonzero.

### SleepUntilIdle

```ts
function SleepUntilIdle(unit: object): void
```

Pauses the script until the unit has no order left.

### Sum

```ts
function Sum(variable: object, group: group, expression: number): number
```

Evaluates the expression once for every object of the group, with the variable set to that object, and returns the sum
of the results.

### WaitSegment

```ts
function WaitSegment(segments: number): void
```

Pauses the called procedure for the given number of segments, 15 to the second. Map script modules only.

## Numbers and logic

Arithmetic, comparisons and rounding. A condition is a number: 0 is false, any other value true.

### Abs

```ts
function Abs(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the absolute value.

### Add

```ts
function Add(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the sum of two or more numbers. Replaces the game's function of two numbers.

### And

```ts
function And(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the logical conjunction of two or more values.

### Ceil

```ts
function Ceil(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Rounds up.

### Cos

```ts
function Cos(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the cosine of a value in radians.

### DistancePointPoint

```ts
function DistancePointPoint(x: number, y: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the distance from the point (x, y) to the origin: the two implicit coordinates are zero.

*Differs from the original:* the last two values are 0 (the original reads past its arguments)

### Div

```ts
function Div(a: number, b: number): number
```

Returns a divided by b.

### Floor

```ts
function Floor(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Rounds down.

### IsEqual

```ts
function IsEqual(a: number, b: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the two numbers are equal, otherwise 0.

### IsEqualString

```ts
function IsEqualString(a: string, b: string): number
```

Returns 1 if the two strings are equal, case included, otherwise 0.

### IsGreater

```ts
function IsGreater(a: number, b: number): number
```

Returns 1 if a is greater than b, otherwise 0.

### IsLess

```ts
function IsLess(a: number, b: number): number
```

Returns 1 if a is less than b, otherwise 0.

### Max

```ts
function Max(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the largest of two or more numbers.

### Min

```ts
function Min(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the smallest of two or more numbers.

### Mul

```ts
function Mul(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the product of two or more numbers. Replaces the game's function of two numbers.

### Not

```ts
function Not(value: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the value is 0, otherwise 0.

### Or

```ts
function Or(a: number, ...b: number[]): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the logical disjunction of two or more values.

### Pow

```ts
function Pow(base: number, exponent: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the base raised to the exponent.

### Random

```ts
function Random(a: number, b?: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

`Random(max)` is the game's random function. `Random(min, max)` returns a random value in the range, or `min` if `max`
is not above `min`. Replaces the game's function of one number.

### Round

```ts
function Round(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Rounds half away from zero.

*Differs from the original:* `Round` is exact (the original gives 8388610 for 8388609 and 1 for 0.49999997)

### Sin

```ts
function Sin(value: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the sine of a value in radians.

### Sub

```ts
function Sub(a: number, b: number): number
```

Returns a minus b.

## Text and console

Strings, and output to the console and the chat.

### ConsoleFloat

```ts
function ConsoleFloat(value: number): void
```

Prints a number to the console. Synonym: `#`.

### ConsoleString

```ts
function ConsoleString(...text: string[]): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Joins the strings and prints them as one console line. Replaces the game's command of one string.

### FloatToStr

```ts
function FloatToStr(value: number, precision?: number): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Converts a number to text. `precision` defaults to 3 and is clamped to 0 to 8; the fraction's trailing zeros are
removed.

*Differs from the original:* `FloatToStr(100, 0)` is `100` (the original removes the integer part's zeros too, giving
`1`)

### RandStr

```ts
function RandStr(text: string, ...more: string[]): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns one of two or more strings at random.

*Differs from the original:* `RandStr` stops on a missing object (the original crashes)

### Say

```ts
function Say(...text: string[]): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Joins the strings and sends them to the multiplayer server chat.

### SendEvent

```ts
function SendEvent(player: number, event: number): void
```

Debug command: broadcasts a number to the engine's players.

### SendStringEvent

```ts
function SendStringEvent(player: number, event: string): void
```

Sends a text command to the engine. `say sNN Name` starts an NPC line (the text `say sNN` of texts.res, with the sound
from the unit's `Acks` field); `say_block` does the same and blocks the speaker. Other commands: `tutorial zt1`,
`briefing`, `autosave`, `endofgame`.

### StrCat

```ts
function StrCat(text: string, ...more: string[]): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Joins two or more strings.

### StrHas

```ts
function StrHas(text: string, fragment: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns 1 if the fragment occurs in the text, otherwise 0.

### StrLen

```ts
function StrLen(text: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the length of a string in bytes.

### StrLower

```ts
function StrLower(text: string): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Converts a string to lowercase by the active code page.

### StrMid

```ts
function StrMid(text: string, start: number, count: number): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns part of a string, by the active code page. `start` counts bytes from 1, and from the end when negative; a
`count` of 0 takes the rest of the string.

### StrToFloat

```ts
function StrToFloat(text: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Converts text to a number.

### StrUpper

```ts
function StrUpper(text: string): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Converts a string to uppercase by the active code page.

## Groups

Sets of objects: diplomatic groups, game groups and the results of group functions.

### AddObject

```ts
function AddObject(group: group, unit: object): void
```

Adds a unit to a game group, a global variable of the script.

### GetObjectsOnMap

```ts
function GetObjectsOnMap(...class: number[]): group
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the group of the objects of the listed classes. -1 selects all.

### GetPlayerUnits

```ts
function GetPlayerUnits(diplomacyGroup: number): group
```

Returns the group of the units of a diplomatic group.

### GroupAdd

```ts
function GroupAdd(a: group, b: group): group
```

Returns the group of the objects that are in either group.

### GroupCross

```ts
function GroupCross(a: group, b: group): group
```

Returns the group of the objects that are in both groups.

### GroupHas

```ts
function GroupHas(group: group, unit: object): number
```

Returns 1 if the group contains the unit, otherwise 0.

### GroupSee

```ts
function GroupSee(group: group): group
```

Returns the group of the objects that the members of the group see at this moment. The members see each other.

### GroupSee - SpellAddon `groupseetrans`

```ts
function GroupSee(group: group, mode: number): group
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] groupseetrans`.

Accepts an extra numeric mode argument. The group traversal itself stays the game's.

### GroupSize

```ts
function GroupSize(group: group): number
```

Returns the number of units in the group.

### GroupSub

```ts
function GroupSub(a: group, b: group): group
```

Returns the group of the objects of the first group that are not in the second.

### PlayerSee

```ts
function PlayerSee(player: number): group
```

Returns the group of the units that the units of the player's party see.

### RandObj

```ts
function RandObj(group: group): object
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns a random member of the group.

### RemoveObject

```ts
function RemoveObject(group: group, unit: object): void
```

Removes a unit from a game group. Not usable from the console.

### UnitSee

```ts
function UnitSee(unit: object): group
```

Returns the group of the units the unit sees. A unit does not see itself.

### UnitSee - SpellAddon `unitseetrans`

```ts
function UnitSee(unit: object, mode: number): group
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] unitseetrans`.

Selects the visibility list: positive zero is the visible living units, a negative sign bit (negative zero included) the
second list, any other value the nearby-units list.

### UnitsNearPoint

```ts
function UnitsNearPoint(x: number, y: number, radius: number, filter: number): group
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the group of the objects within the radius that pass the filter. Filter bits: 1 units, 2 other objects, 4 living
named objects.

## Objects and positions

Finding objects, reading their positions and placing them on the map.

### AddMob

```ts
function AddMob(file: string): void
```

Loads a `.mob` file from the `MAPS` folder; the name includes the extension.

### AddMob - SpellAddon `infiniteaddmobspawn`

```ts
function AddMob(file: string): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] infiniteaddmobspawn`.

Can load the same file repeatedly, except case-sensitive names that begin with `Auto`, which still load once. Active for
values 1 and up.

### AddMobEx

```ts
function AddMobEx(file: string, skipScripts?: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Adds the objects of a `.mob` file without a loading movie, and optionally skips its scripts.

### AddUnitToServer

```ts
function AddUnitToServer(mapName: string, prototype: string, displayName: string, x: number, y: number, z: number): void
```

Places a unit of the given prototype on the map at (x, y, z). `mapName` is its internal name, case-sensitive;
`displayName` is the name shown in info windows.

### DistanceUnitPoint

```ts
function DistanceUnitPoint(unit: object, x: number, y: number): number
```

Returns the straight distance between an object and a point.

### DistanceUnitUnit

```ts
function DistanceUnitUnit(unitA: object, unitB: object): number
```

Returns the straight distance between two objects.

### GetBSZValue

```ts
function GetBSZValue(x: number, y: number): number
```

Returns the height of the surface at the point: like `GetZValue`, except that an unfrozen pool of water or lava gives
the height of its surface, not of its bottom.

### GetFutureX

```ts
function GetFutureX(object: object, ticks: number): number
```

Returns the x coordinate the object is predicted to have after the given time, in 1/15 s units. The shorter the time,
the better the prediction.

### GetFutureY

```ts
function GetFutureY(object: object, ticks: number): number
```

Returns the y coordinate the object is predicted to have after the given time, in 1/15 s units.

### GetLeader

```ts
function GetLeader(): object
```

Returns the leader of the current party: Zak in single player, the player's current character in multiplayer.

### GetObject

```ts
function GetObject(id: number): object
```

Returns the object with the given ID. Does not work with ten-digit IDs: use `GetObjectByID`.

### GetObjectByID

```ts
function GetObjectByID(id: string): object
```

Returns the object with the given ID, written as a string. Accepts ten-digit IDs.

### GetObjectByName

```ts
function GetObjectByName(name: string): object
```

Returns the object with the given in-game name.

### GetObjectID

```ts
function GetObjectID(object: object): number
```

Returns the ID of an object, a unit or any other object such as a chest.

### GetObjectStringID

```ts
function GetObjectStringID(object: object): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the ID of an object as a decimal string.

### GetObjectTypeID

```ts
function GetObjectTypeID(object: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the class ID of an object, or -1.

### GetPrototype

```ts
function GetPrototype(unit: object): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the name of the unit's prototype.

*Differs from the original:* stops on a missing object (the original crashes)

### GetRace

```ts
function GetRace(unit: object): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the model name of the unit.

*Differs from the original:* stops on a missing object (the original crashes)

### GetX

```ts
function GetX(object: object): number
```

Returns the x coordinate of an object.

### GetY

```ts
function GetY(object: object): number
```

Returns the y coordinate of an object.

### GetZ

```ts
function GetZ(object: object): number
```

Returns the z coordinate of an object.

### GetZValue

```ts
function GetZValue(x: number, y: number): number
```

Returns the height of the solid ground at the point, whatever water or lava lies over it.

### HideObject

```ts
function HideObject(object: object, hide: number): void
```

Hides the object if `hide` is nonzero, shows it if 0. Works in briefing zones only.

### IsInArea

```ts
function IsInArea(area: number, x: number, y: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the point (x, y) lies in a part of the quest area, otherwise 0.

### IsInSquare

```ts
function IsInSquare(x: number, y: number, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the point (x, y) lies in the rectangle (x1, y1)-(x2, y2), otherwise 0.

### IsUnitInWater

```ts
function IsUnitInWater(unit: object): number
```

Returns 1 if the unit is in water, otherwise 0.

### IsUnitVisible

```ts
function IsUnitVisible(unit: object): number
```

Returns 1 if the player can see the unit in the zone, otherwise 0. `HideObject` does not change the result.

### NearestUnit

```ts
function NearestUnit(x: number, y: number, radius: number, filter: number): object
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the nearest object within the radius that passes the filter, or no object. Filter bits: 1 units, 2 other
objects, 4 living named objects.

### RemoveObjectFromServer

```ts
function RemoveObjectFromServer(object: object): void
```

Removes the object from the server. Same as `RemoveUnitFromServer`.

### RemoveUnitFromServer

```ts
function RemoveUnitFromServer(unit: object): void
```

Removes the object from the server. Same as `RemoveObjectFromServer`.

### SetCP

```ts
function SetCP(object: object, x: number, y: number, z: number): void
```

Moves any map object, not only a unit, to (x, y). A unit loses its orders, and the passability graph is recalculated,
which is slower than `SetCPFast`.

### SetCPFast

```ts
function SetCPFast(object: object, x: number, y: number, z: number): void
```

Like `SetCP`, but the AI passability graph is not recalculated.

### UnitInSquare

```ts
function UnitInSquare(unit: object, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the unit stands in the rectangle (x1, y1)-(x2, y2), otherwise 0.

## Units and statistics

Health, mana, attributes, skills and experience.

### BlockUnit

```ts
function BlockUnit(unit: object, block: number): void
```

Blocks the player's control of a unit if `block` is nonzero, gives it back if 0. A unit can be controlled from the
moment it joins a party.

### GetActions

```ts
function GetActions(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the current action count of a unit.

### GetActionsBase

```ts
function GetActionsBase(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the base action count of a unit.

### GetAIClass

```ts
function GetAIClass(unit: object): number
```

Returns what the unit is doing: 0 calm, 1 moving, 2 turning, 3 attacking, 4 casting, 5 using a skill, 6 following.

### GetAIClass - SpellAddon `getaiclasstrans`

```ts
function GetAIClass(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] getaiclasstrans`.

Reads the AI class field of the unit's server controller.

### GetArmor

```ts
function GetArmor(unit: object, kind: number, part: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the protection of a unit. `kind` 0 to 5 selects a body slot's layers and `part` 0 to 6 a damage type; a negative
`kind` uses the computed protection.

### GetDexterity

```ts
function GetDexterity(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the dexterity of a unit.

### GetEncumbrance

```ts
function GetEncumbrance(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the load a unit carries.

### GetIntelligence

```ts
function GetIntelligence(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the intelligence of a unit.

### GetMaxEncumbrance

```ts
function GetMaxEncumbrance(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the load a unit can carry.

### GetPerk

```ts
function GetPerk(unit: object, name: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the level of a perk of a unit. Names: `sword`, `axe`, `dagger`, `spear`, `hammer`, `bow`, `crossbow`, `fire`,
`lightning`, `acid`, `illusion`, `divination`, `enchantments`, `healing`, `domination`, `infra`, `health`, `mana`,
`vitality`, `spirit`, `quickness`, `lift`, `backstab`, `strength`, `dexterity`, `intelligence`.

### GetSkill

```ts
function GetSkill(unit: object, name: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns a skill or attribute of a unit: `science`, `melee`, `archery`, `elemental`, `sense` or `astral`.

### GetStrength

```ts
function GetStrength(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the strength of a unit.

### GetUnitExp

```ts
function GetUnitExp(unit: object, what?: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns the experience of a unit: `max` (the default), `spent`, `penalty` (the experience not yet added) or `real`
(experience plus penalty).

### GiveDexterity

```ts
function GiveDexterity(unit: object, amount: number): void
```

Adds dexterity points to a unit. Zones only; works on enemies as well.

### GiveExp

```ts
function GiveExp(player: number, amount: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Awards experience to a player's party.

### GiveIntelligence

```ts
function GiveIntelligence(unit: object, amount: number): void
```

Adds intelligence points to a unit. Zones only; works on enemies as well.

### GiveSkill

```ts
function GiveSkill(unit: object, skill: string, amount: number): void
```

Raises a skill (`science`, `melee`, `archery`, and so on) by `amount` points. The experience needed is added to the
unit, not to the party, and spent on the skill, so health and stamina follow.

### GiveStrength

```ts
function GiveStrength(unit: object, amount: number): void
```

Adds strength points to a unit. Zones only; works on enemies as well.

### GiveUnitExp

```ts
function GiveUnitExp(unit: object, amount: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Awards experience to one unit.

*Differs from the original:* `GiveUnitExp` stops on a missing object (the original crashes)

### HP

```ts
function HP(unit: object): number
```

Returns the unit's current health, with the effects of weakening and strengthening spells.

### HP - SpellAddon `hptrans`

```ts
function HP(unit: object, index: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] hptrans`.

Reads a float by index from the unit's vitals. Valid indices are 0 to 29; the fields are listed under [indexed stat
readers](spelladdon.md#indexed-stat-readers).

### InflictDamage

```ts
function InflictDamage(unit: object, amount: number): void
```

Deals damage to the unit, ignoring its armor. Experience is granted for a kill.

### IsAlive

```ts
function IsAlive(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns 1 if the unit is alive. Returns 0 for a missing object or a non-unit. Replaces the game's function.

### IsDead

```ts
function IsDead(unit: object): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns 1 if the unit is dead. Returns 0 for a missing object or a non-unit. Replaces the game's function.

### IsUnitBlocked

```ts
function IsUnitBlocked(unit: object): number
```

Returns 1 if the player's control of the unit is blocked, otherwise 0.

### KillUnit

```ts
function KillUnit(unit: object): void
```

Kills the unit. The party gets no experience for it.

### Mana

```ts
function Mana(unit: object): number
```

Returns the unit's current mana.

### Mana - SpellAddon `mptrans`

```ts
function Mana(unit: object, index: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] mptrans`.

Reads a float from the unit's stats, indices 0 to 448; an invalid object, controller or index returns 0. The fields are
listed under [indexed stat readers](spelladdon.md#indexed-stat-readers). Also adds the index argument to `HP`, which
keeps its reader unless `hptrans` is 1.

### MaxHP

```ts
function MaxHP(unit: object): number
```

Returns the unit's maximum health, with the effects of weakening and strengthening spells.

## Orders and behaviour

Orders to units, their stances, and the behaviours of the AI.

### AlarmPosX

```ts
function AlarmPosX(alarm: number): number
```

Returns the x coordinate of the point set for the alarm number by `InvokeAlarm`.

### AlarmPosY

```ts
function AlarmPosY(alarm: number): number
```

Returns the y coordinate of the point set for the alarm number by `InvokeAlarm`.

### AlarmTime

```ts
function AlarmTime(alarm: number): number
```

Returns the time counter of the alarm number, in 1/15 s units. The counter runs while the alarm is the active one.

### Attack

```ts
function Attack(unit: object, target: object): void
```

Orders the unit to attack the target.

### Crawl

```ts
function Crawl(unit: object): void
```

Sets the unit's stance to crouching.

### Crawl - SpellAddon `crawltrans`

```ts
function Crawl(unit: object, slot: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] crawltrans`.

Requests a weapon slot instead of setting the crawl style.

### Follow

```ts
function Follow(unit: object, target: object): void
```

Orders the unit to follow the target once. The order ends after a fight. See `UMFollow`.

### Guard

```ts
function Guard(unit: object, x: number, y: number, radius: number): void
```

Orders the unit to guard the area of the given radius around (x, y), moving about in it.

### Idle

```ts
function Idle(unit: object): void
```

Drops all behaviours and the current order of the unit: it stands and does nothing.

### InvokeAlarm

```ts
function InvokeAlarm(alarm: number, x: number, y: number): void
```

Raises the alarm with the given number at the point (x, y). Only one alarm is active at a time: a new number replaces
the previous one. Enemies with that alarm number in their `.mob` go to the point and guard it. `InvokeAlarm(0, 0, 0)`
clears the alarm, and they return to their places.

### IsAlarm

```ts
function IsAlarm(alarm: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the alarm number has been raised, otherwise 0.

### Lie

```ts
function Lie(unit: object): void
```

Sets the unit's stance to lying down.

### MoveToObject

```ts
function MoveToObject(unit: object, target: object): void
```

Orders the unit to walk, in its current stance, to the place where the target stands at this moment. The unit does not
follow the target.

### MoveToObject - SpellAddon `movetoobjecttrans`

```ts
function MoveToObject(unit: object, target: object, skill?: number, unused?: number, run?: number, slot?: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] movetoobjecttrans`.

Value 1: `MoveToObject(unit, target)` performs thieving while walking. Value 2: runs instead. Value 3 and up: the four
numbers after the target supply the thieving order.

### MoveToPoint

```ts
function MoveToPoint(unit: object, x: number, y: number): void
```

Orders the unit to move to the point (x, y).

### PlayAnimation

```ts
function PlayAnimation(unit: object, animation: string): void
```

Plays an animation from the unit's `.adb` file (`res/database.res/<mask name>.adb`; the mask is in `RaceModels.txt`).
The first letter of the name sets the kind: `u` plays once, then back to normal; `c` loops, and the unit ignores
everything until the next order; `s` is one step of a movement. Families: `uattack01..09`, `udeath01..31`,
`cidle01..09`, `ucast01..04`, `uhit01..21`, `crun01..02`, `cwalk01..09`, `ccrawl01`, `ucross01..09`, `scross01..09`,
`crest`; humans also have `ubriefing##`, `uspecial##` and `cspecial##`. An unknown name does nothing.

### ResetTarget

```ts
function ResetTarget(unit: object): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Resets the unit's perception and reapplies its alarm state. Resets all guard, patrol and aggression behaviours: call it
before building a patrol or guard list. Replaces the game's command.

*Differs from the original:* refuses a negative slot or a unit without a controller

### Rest

```ts
function Rest(unit: object): void
```

Orders the unit to rest. It sits down when it can.

### RotateTo

```ts
function RotateTo(unit: object, x: number, y: number): void
```

Turns the unit to face the point (x, y). Does nothing right after `AddUnitToServer`: the unit has to exist on the map
first.

### Run

```ts
function Run(unit: object): void
```

Sets the unit's stance to running.

### Run - SpellAddon `runtrans`

```ts
function Run(unit: object, style: number): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] runtrans`.

Sets the requested movement style instead of always selecting run.

### Sentry

```ts
function Sentry(unit: object, x: number, y: number): void
```

Orders the unit to guard the point (x, y) and attack the enemies it sees. It returns to the point afterwards.

### SetEnemy

```ts
function SetEnemy(unit: object, diplomacyGroup: number): void
```

Makes the diplomatic group hostile to the unit, as if one of its members had attacked it. Units only.

### SetPlayerAggression

```ts
function SetPlayerAggression(a: number, b: number): void
```

Does nothing.

### SetSpellAggression

```ts
function SetSpellAggression(unit: object, aggression: number): void
```

Does nothing.

### Stand

```ts
function Stand(unit: object): void
```

Sets the unit's stance to walking, as `Walk`.

### Stand - SpellAddon `standtrans`

```ts
function Stand(unit: object): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] standtrans`.

Also revives the unit. A non-unit argument causes no revival.

*Differs from the original:* does nothing for an argument that is not a unit (the original crashes)

### StartAnimation

```ts
function StartAnimation(unit: object, path: string): void
```

Not implemented in game.exe: does nothing. Use `PlayAnimation`.

### UMAg

```ts
function UMAg(unit: object, preset: number): void
```

Replaces the unit's fear, aggression and suspicion behaviours with a preset: 0 always afraid (flees), 1 afraid (fear
without the "always" flag), 2 revenge plus fear. Each preset also adds suspicion and corpse watching.

### UMAggression

```ts
function UMAggression(unit: object): void
```

Adds aggression: the unit attacks the enemies it sees.

### UMClear

```ts
function UMClear(unit: object): void
```

Removes all independent behaviours of the unit. The current order stays.

### UMCorpseWatcher

```ts
function UMCorpseWatcher(unit: object): void
```

Adds corpse watching: the unit reacts to dead bodies.

### UMFear

```ts
function UMFear(unit: object, always: number): void
```

Makes the unit never attack and try to hide from enemies, the default of neutral beasts. If `always` is nonzero, the
unit fears the player for good.

### UMFollow

```ts
function UMFollow(unit: object, target: object): void
```

Orders the unit to follow the target for good. The order survives a fight. See `Follow`.

### UMGuard

```ts
function UMGuard(unit: object, x: number, y: number, radius: number): void
```

Makes the unit guard the point (x, y) within the radius.

### UMGuardEx

```ts
function UMGuardEx(unit: object, x: number, y: number, radius: number, delay: number): void
```

Makes the unit guard the point (x, y) within the radius, pausing for `delay` at random stopping points.

### UMPatrol

```ts
function UMPatrol(unit: object): void
```

Adds a patrol behaviour. The command raises an error in the game. To make a unit patrol, call `ResetTarget`, then
`UMPatrolAddPoint`.

### UMPatrolAddPoint

```ts
function UMPatrolAddPoint(unit: object, x: number, y: number): void
```

Adds the patrol point (x, y). Does nothing when the unit has no patrol behaviour. Add `UMPatrolAddPointLook` after it to
make the unit wait there.

### UMPatrolAddPointLook

```ts
function UMPatrolAddPointLook(unit: object, x: number, y: number, delay: number): void
```

Sets the point (x, y) the unit looks at, and the time `delay` it stays, at the last patrol point.

### UMPatrolClear

```ts
function UMPatrolClear(unit: object): void
```

Removes all patrol points of the unit. `ResetTarget` also resets the other behaviours.

### UMPlayer

```ts
function UMPlayer(unit: object): void
```

Makes the unit obey the rules of a player's unit, which gives sensible behaviour. Briefing zones use it for scripted
NPCs. Clears the unit's other behaviours and orders.

### UMRevenge

```ts
function UMRevenge(unit: object): void
```

Gives the unit conditional fear: it runs away from everyone hostile and fights only when wounded or cornered.

### UMSentry

```ts
function UMSentry(unit: object, x: number, y: number): void
```

Makes the unit guard the point (x, y) and attack the enemies it sees. It returns to the point afterwards.

### UMStandard

```ts
function UMStandard(unit: object): void
```

Gives the unit the behaviour of a standard enemy: aggression, suspicion and corpse watching.

### UMSuspection

```ts
function UMSuspection(unit: object): void
```

Adds suspicion: the unit goes to the nearest enemy it sees.

### WaitEndAnimation

```ts
function WaitEndAnimation(): void
```

Not implemented in game.exe: does nothing.

### Walk

```ts
function Walk(unit: object): void
```

Sets the unit's stance to walking.

player. `to` is `PartyName::Name`.

Creates a party for the player. A party of the same name is replaced. The name is case-sensitive.

### GetMercsNumber


Returns the number of mercenaries in the player's current party, the leader not counted.

### GetPlayer

```ts

```

### GetPlayerOfUnit

```ts

```

### IsPlayer

```ts

```

Returns 1 if the player's danger state is "in danger", otherwise 0 (also for a player that does not exist). The state

return 0.

### IsPlayerInSafety

```ts
function IsPlayerInSafety(player: number): number
```

Returns 1 if the player's danger state is "safe", otherwise 0 (also for a player that does not exist). Not the opposite
of `IsPlayerInDanger`: at the state's in-between value both return 0.

```ts
function PlayerExists(player: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Returns 1 if the player exists, otherwise 0.



<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] setplayertrans`.

## Quests

Dynamic quests of multiplayer zones.

### QFinish

```ts
function QFinish(): void
```

Completes the quest started by `QStart`. In single player the quest's experience is paid too.

### QObjArea


Quest objective: enter the area. The area is a virtual object made of all the parts with that ID, usually area 1.

### QObjGetItem


Quest objective: get the quest item with the ID. A macro for ordinary commands.

### QObjKillGroup

```ts
function QObjKillGroup(group: string): void
```

Quest objective: kill the whole game group, given by the name of its global variable.

### QObjKillUnit

```ts
function QObjKillUnit(unitName: string): void
```

Quest objective: kill the named unit. A macro for ordinary commands.

### QObjSeeObject

```ts
function QObjSeeObject(objectName: string): void
```

Quest objective: see the named object, a chest and not a unit. A macro for ordinary commands.

### QObjSeeUnit

```ts
function QObjSeeUnit(unitName: string): void
```

Quest objective: see the named unit. A macro for ordinary commands.

### QObjUse

```ts
function QObjUse(lever: string, state: number): void
```

Quest objective: put the lever into the state. A macro for ordinary commands.

### QStart

```ts
function QStart(name: string): void
```

Starts a dynamic multiplayer quest and opens its list of objectives, which ends with `QFinish`.

### QuestComplete

```ts
function QuestComplete(player: number, name: string): void
```

Completes the quest and pays its experience, like `QFinish` but without the message in the info window.

### CreateLightning


Creates a lightning that stays, from (x1, y1, z1) to (x2, y2, z2). A positive intensity ends the bolt in a ball, as if
it hit an object.

```ts

```

Creates a particle source of the given type at (x, y, z). A negative radius flips the source upside down.

### CreatePointLight

```ts

```

Creates a point light of the given color at (x, y, z). A torch or a campfire at night is a light; a dim one darkens a
dense forest by day.


Creates a looping sound source placed at random inside the box x1..x2, y1..y2, z1..z2. Remove it with `DeleteFXSource`.

### IsNight

```ts

```

Returns how dark it is, from 0 to 1, by the game's hour of day: 0 from 8:00 to 20:00, rising evenly from 0 at 20:00 to 1
at 24:00, and 1 from 0:00 until 8:00, when it drops to 0 at once. The server updates it every tick.

### PlayMusic


Plays the piece `STREAM\<name>` for the player, the name without its extension. The name `0` turns the zone's music off,
`1` on.

### PlayMusic - SpellAddon `playmusictrans`

```ts
function PlayMusic(player: number, name: string): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> SpellAddon option `[gameplay] playmusictrans`.

Values 1 and 2: the name `"0"` or `"1"` re-selects the local map's music theme and sets the music system's level to the
digit. The first character selects this behavior. Value 1 uses the map's theme, value 2 its alternative name field.
Other text, or no map or music system, uses normal handling.

*Differs from the original:* without a map or a music system, does what the game does (the original crashes)

## Game and system

Zone changes, game modes, game end and files.

### GameOver

```ts
function GameOver(): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Ends player 0's game with the default title and text, the text keys `game_over` and `game_over_msg`.

### GameOverMSG

```ts
function GameOverMSG(title: string, text: string): void
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Ends player 0's game with the given text keys for title and text.

### GodMode

```ts
function GodMode(player: number, mode: number): void
```

Sets the mode of the player's current party: 0 normal, 1 invulnerable when running and mana is free, 2 like 1, and every
hit kills.

### IsFileExists

```ts
function IsFileExists(path: string): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Tests whether a file exists under the mod folder. A path that climbs to a parent folder is refused.

### GSGetIniNumber

```ts
function GSGetIniNumber(file: string, section: string, key: string, default: number): number
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Reads a value from an INI file of the mod folder, at the call, as a number; `default` when the file, section or key is
missing or the value is not a number. The file is a path below the mod folder, with `/` or `\` as separators; an
absolute path, a drive letter or a `..` component is refused and gives `default`. The decimal point is `.` or `,`. File,
section and key are matched without regard to case. A missing value or a refusal is logged once per file, section and
key.

### GSGetIniString

```ts
function GSGetIniString(file: string, section: string, key: string, default: string): string
```

<span class="eix">eix</span> Added by addon.dll.

Reads a value from an INI file of the mod folder, at the call, as text; `default` when the file, section or key is
missing. The path and matching rules are those of `GSGetIniNumber`. A key with an empty value gives an empty string.
